prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a growing paper column; paper coins.
Opens on the folder stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips down as the folder stack rises into a tall paper column; coins pile at its base and hold.
Ends holding on the column.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "G&A $8.1M".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "G&A $8.1M". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage style, presented as a flat lay photographed under soft, natural room light. <Picture 1> establishes the scene: a deep magenta single-color paper ground filling the frame, with a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a stack of blank office folders featuring rough white torn-paper edges. A cream-colored paper chip with the black text "4 ACQUISITIONS" is positioned in the upper third of the frame. A consistent light source from the upper left casts small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. On the first frame, the camera is a Static Shot. The "4 ACQUISITIONS" chip quickly flips downward and slides off-frame, revealing a new cream paper chip that lands firmly in the upper third, printed with the stable, extra-bold black sans-serif text "G&A $8.1M". Simultaneously, the folder stack in the lower two-thirds of the frame transforms; the folders slide and stack vertically with a fast motion and slight overshoot, growing into a tall, singular paper column. As the column reaches its peak, several black-and-white halftone paper coins, also featuring rough white torn edges and blank surfaces, slide in rapidly from the sides and pile up at the base of the column. All elements possess a matte printed paper texture with visible print dots. The animation holds the final composition of the column and coin pile against the deep magenta background for the remaining duration, with a subtle, rhythmic micro-loop of the paper elements shifting slightly to maintain a sense of life.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the crisp, tactile sounds of physical paper manipulation. Distinct, sharp paper-slap sounds synchronize with the landing of the headline chip and the growth of the column, accompanied by the short, sticky rip of adhesive tape.
